bias.zh: 中性 · 守住 30 日与 200 日均线

read.en: Rockwell edged up 0.3% on Oct 12 to $433.97, holding above its 30-day ($430) and 200-day ($425) averages after the Oct 8 dip to $426. It is below the 5 and 10-day averages ($439–441) and the 100-day ($449). The MACD histogram has shrunk to almost zero, so a bearish cross is close, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8, and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 10月12日小涨 0.3%，收于 $433.97，在 10月8日下探 $426 后守在 30 日（$430）和 200 日均线（$425）上方。股价位于 5 日和 10 日均线（$439–441）及 100 日均线（$449）下方。MACD 柱体已缩至接近零，即将死叉，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空，RSI 为 49。

read.en: Support is $425–430 (30 and 200-day averages, Oct 8 low), then $407 (Sep 17 low) and $396. Resistance is $439–441, then $449–456, where the 100-day average sits and five swings have stalled, and the Oct 6 high of $460.
